overview: The committee discussed preparations for the October Harvest Your Energy Festival, rescheduled its next meeting, and reviewed municipal sustainability projects ahead of the Climate Planner's transition out of her role.

items.title: Fall Meeting Schedule Adjustment
items.summary: The committee rescheduled its first autumn meeting from Labor Day to September 14th.

items.title: Municipal Climate and Infrastructure Updates
items.summary: Climate Planner Brenda Pike highlighted upcoming public events, a new cooling resources map, and a minor vandalism incident at the municipal wind turbine.

items.title: Harvest Your Energy Festival Planning
items.summary: Planning intern Kyla updated the committee on vendors and logistics for the October 17th festival, soliciting suggestions for local sustainable artists and kids' environmental games.

items.title: Member Updates and Public Tree Ordinance
items.summary: The committee reviewed upcoming zero-waste swap events and discussed the City Council Committee of the Whole's recent favorable vote on the public tree ordinance.

items.title: Ridwell Specialty Recycling Discussion
items.summary: Members discussed the specialty waste collection company Ridwell, raising questions regarding the efficacy and validity of its recycling claims.

items.title: Climate Planner Transition and Outstanding Projects
items.summary: Brenda Pike detailed ongoing and future sustainability initiatives for the incoming climate planner, covering green community certifications, school electrification projects, and EV fleet policies.
